standard.summary: 梯度检查点与 CPU offload 结合模式：none=不结合；auto=自动选择；full=完整 offload。
standard.whenToUse: 不确定时先保持默认，小步数短测后再调。
standard.avoidWhen: 与预检冲突或与其它互斥选项同时开启时。

optionDescriptions.none: 检查点和 CPU offload 不绑。
optionDescriptions.full: 绑死，GPU 最省，反向加拷贝最慢。

standard_en.summary: How gradient checkpointing combines with CPU offload: none = not combined; auto = decided automatically; full = full offload.
standard_en.whenToUse: When unsure keep the default; run a short low-step test before changing it.
standard_en.avoidWhen: When it conflicts with preflight, or when a mutually exclusive option is enabled at the same time.

optionDescriptions.none: Checkpointing and CPU offload stay unlinked.
optionDescriptions.full: Links them firmly: easiest on the GPU, slowest backward because of the copies.

advanced.principle: 梯度检查点与 CPU offload 结合模式：none=不结合；auto=自动选择；full=完整 offload。

advanced_en.principle: How gradient checkpointing combines with CPU offload: none = no combining; auto = chosen automatically; full = full offload.
